_comment: Example parameter file. The deploy workflow (.github/workflows/deploy.yml) passes parameters INLINE (az deployment group create ... --parameters appName=... image=...), so this file is NOT used by CI — it exists only for manual `az deployment group create --parameters @infra/main.parameters.json`. Replace the placeholders + appName/image for a manual deploy. By default the template provisions a storage account (provisionStorage default true); set it to false to bring your own. Secrets are Container App secrets passed as parameters (no Key Vault). provisionRedis defaults FALSE: the template is single-replica and the app refuses to boot when PAD_REDIS_URL is set but unreachable, so Redis is only worth its cost and its failure mode once maxReplicas > 1. registryUsername/registryPassword (a GHCR PAT with read:packages) are required unless the image package is public; metricsToken gates GET /metrics. alertEmails is empty by default — set it to receive operational alerts.

encryptionKey.value: <openssl rand -hex 32, different from authSecret; set before users store provider keys>
